headline: Long-read and learned models expand genome-resolved microbial diversity surveys
label: Microbial Genome Diversity Surveys
summary: Reprocessed cross-cohort repositories and pangenome-aware tools now enable genome-resolved surveys of microbial diversity at larger scale.
synthesis: The dominant thread is computational infrastructure that converts microbial sequencing data into resolved genomic and gene-level inference. Myloasm assembles long-read metagenomes using polymorphic k-mers and differential abundance to simplify string graphs. Panmap places, aligns, and genotypes reads on mutation-annotated pangenomes using a phylogenetically compressed k-mer index. MetaGEAR Explorer supports interactive gene-centric searches over 33M gene families across 24 metagenomic IBD and CRC cohorts. The Celiac Microbiome Repository curates 28 celiac disease datasets comprising 3,245 samples from 16S and shotgun sequencing, reprocessed with DADA2. What is new is the packaging of reprocessed, cross-cohort data and reference-aware tools for reuse at genotype and gene resolution. The items differ in data type, scale, and method, so this describes the dominant pattern rather than a feature shared by every item.
